notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 116-assertion HLA_EVOKED three-member ordinary timestamped-interaction restore case. One parameter-bearing TSO is queued for two constrained recipients when all members complete an untimed save. Post-save Retract terminalizes the same saved designator. Restore reconstructs both pending copies and the live retraction record. Each recipient's independent Flush Queue Request delivers the original payload, tag, producer, timestamp, designator, callback order, grant time, and optimistic time. Retract then invokes Request Retraction at both recipients and terminalizes the record again. This differs from single-recipient saved-live rollback and multi-recipient directed delivery. Isolated C++ primary/contract passed using only installed 2026-10-20 package libraries with integer64 and float64 time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 interaction FOM and parameter, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-boundary restore, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
